_about: Golden set of agent questions for execute_plan. Gate for PRs touching the planner, the answer composer or the citation code (scripts/golden-run.mjs, scripts/golden-compare.mjs, .github/workflows/golden-gate.yml). PJM and SERC places only (Ashburn, Loudoun, Columbus OH, Charlotte): no ERCOT, MISO or AZ question here (DCPI hold). Written 2026-11-24 by hand: the Grok head-to-head folders are not on this Mac; the one local note (brain-to-grok-2026-11-18-h2h-remaining-gaps) gave the PJM wholesale and the VA queue-with-a-size-floor questions. expect_class lists the planner classes that answer the question correctly; the gate fails when an intent that matched in the base run no longer does.
